Rules say what share of the end users they match get the flag: those a rule names one by one, and
everyone its --when conditions hold for. 'voidhash flag view' shows them in the order they are read.

Usage:
  voidhash flag rule <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  rule, rules

Commands:
  add        Add a rule: who it matches, and the share of them who get the flag.
  remove     Remove a rule from a flag.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash flag rule <command> --help' for more about a command.
